description: DiligenceOps: return a signed field and freshness report for supplied JSON, a live Coinbase Exchange ticker, or a public HTTPS JSON URL. Use payload for a sample up to 256 KB, or live with provider and symbol or with url. The receipt binds the report to the analyzed data. Live receipts record the source, observation time and raw body digest. POST /api/data-evidence-check. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with shared signed-wallet free access. Read /api/data-evidence-check-contract for arguments, limits and the receipt key.

endpoint.description: Original source URL for a submitted sample.

payload.description: JSON object or serialized object or array (256 KB).
